parameters.query: UPDATE support_messages SET status='failed', error=$2, updated_at=now() WHERE execution_id=$1 RETURNING id, sender;

parameters.content:
## Global error workflow
Any unhandled error in the main workflow: mark the row status=failed (found via execution_id) and alert the team. Re-sending the same message re-claims a failed row.
